purpose: Read-only integration/platform parity review. No production edits, test execution, live profile/credential reads or remote mutations.

coverage.rule: Overlapping inventory procedures and UI contracts are not independent completion units. Root owns the complete function index. Preserved source, a native implementation, and passing bounded tests are distinct evidence levels.

priorAuditCaveats: reference-readiness.json and feature-progress-update.json retain the earlier continuation checkpoint and pending-publication wording; later plugin/live/Send-fix evidence supersedes those dated statuses.
Historical git implementation audits list host/settings/watchers as pending; current source and newer host tests show those integrations are now connected.
No exhaustive paired native/upstream session or function-by-function differential test was run by this review.

implemented: System-Git status/branches/remotes/worktrees, source-ref fetch, create/switch, file diffs and explicit removal; busy/dirty-editor/terminal guards and setup-after-mount are connected.
Real scratch-clone worktree actions and Windows long-path behavior have separate retained evidence.
gaps: Native pane differs from source popover/Monaco diff; binary/submodule/symlink presentation remains limited.
Commit/push buttons are not present in the examined source Git RPC contract. Shell or GitHub REST actions are separate capabilities.
No exhaustive Git-version/hooks/remote-auth/filesystem compatibility claim.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Source return-shape differential fixtures and remaining diff presentations without weakening mutation guards.

implemented: One current workspace per conversation; explicit removal detaches affected chats and persists them.
gaps: Source maintains multiple mounted prefixes/runtimes per agent; native uses sole ws1 plus specialized apps/att/shells mounts.
Source deletion workflow optionally deletes related chats after successful removal; native host currently detaches them without that optional multi-chat deletion action.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Stable persisted mount IDs with per-mount revoke/cancel/fork/restart tests and exact source removal policy.

implemented: Per-repository scripts, revision-aware save, BOM/EOL preservation, Codex TOML fallback, execution only after successful mount, bounded output/cancel/deadline and isolated drafts.
gaps: Windows execution verified; native POSIX/macOS deployment unavailable.
Scripts deliberately retain user OS authority.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Source environment-variable/platform-selection corpus and platform-specific process tests.

implemented: Shared owners, asynchronous fingerprint/debounce, atomic HEAD replacement, topology changes, disappearance/reappearance and stale-owner cancellation.
gaps: Native path/repository/scan budgets report incomplete state; not unbounded cross-platform parity.
Latest sharing failure was a fixture atomic-replacement primitive mismatch, not evidence of a newly fixed production watcher bug.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Retain source ignore/topology semantic fixtures and explicit bounded-incomplete behavior.

implemented: Backend checks managed/clean/unmounted/attached/merged/seven-day age; unknown usage fails closed. Optional usage journal is preserved/tested but unlinked to ADE.
gaps: MainWindow always sets usageKnown=false, so automatic age/history cleanup and startup prompt/snooze are unavailable.
Current workspace/updated is not equivalent to source mountedWorkspaces/lastMessageAt history.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Durable physical-identity-aware usage history, unknown-history floor, host lifecycle events, then candidate review/snooze and fresh guarded removal.

implemented: ConPTY/libvterm input, copy/paste, scrollback, resize, owned process lifetime and borrowed agent-shell views.
gaps: No source-equivalent persisted terminal-tab recreation or cross-platform PTY/shell discovery. Persistent shell sessions are a distinct capability.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Typed terminal descriptors with validated cwd and explicit fresh-process restart, without claiming process resurrection.

implemented: createShellSession/executeShellCommand/createWatcherSession, persistent cwd/variables, stdin/poll/kill, five active sessions, paced input, authenticated OSC completion and ownership/cancel.
gaps: PowerShell only; no Bash/Zsh or source sentinel fallback when OSC initialization fails.
PCRE2 differs from JS RegExp; retained exited grids32 sessions/200 rows is an explicit native choice.
Commands retain user OS permissions, not an OS sandbox.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Source shell-detection/environment/integration adapters with chunked completion/failure/cancel fixtures.

implemented: Process-local one-shot watchers, per-round manifest, accepted durable queue wake preserving pause/question/approval, bounded failed-save retry;50MiB logs and readonly exact/raw plus immutable formatted reads; clone logs without processes.
gaps: Failed queue writes retained only in memory, not crash durable.
Source revision/delta environment representation differs. Raw log transfer4MiB/64Ki chars; shells glob/grep missing.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Source environment-state comparison and historical log navigation without conflating logs with active processes.

implemented: Ask/Allow and source-derived create/owned-kill approval bypass.
gaps: No Smart classifier model fallback/schema/timeout/decision explanation.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Fail-closed classifier, exact command/cwd identity, stale cancellation and actual-engine approval tests.

implemented: Owned shell enumeration/kill is available.
gaps: No local listening-port scanner or source discovered server list/stop workflow.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Read-only OS port discovery and exact process ownership; never infer stop authority from port number alone.

implemented: Workspace/global .stagewise/.agents, opt-in Codex/Claude, precedence, scoped AGENTS.md, enablement, slash flags and readonly references.
gaps: Bounded custom frontmatter parser is not full gray-matter/YAML parity;512 skills/2048 children/1MiB caps.
Single workspace prevents source multiprefix ownership parity.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Source YAML/duplicate/symlink precedence corpus and per-mount context lifetime tests.

implemented: Five PAT skills/assets with provenance, enablement, DPAPI token save/remove/read-check and actual host/worker fetch; CLI smoke loads same plugin context.
GitHub live native chat covered identity/repo plus disposable branch/content/PR/merge/cleanup; main stayed unchanged during that validation.
gaps: Other four services have synthetic transport/runtime tests, not live account operation verification. Read checks prove only their endpoint/current permissions.

Source discovery loads bundled plugin directories; an arbitrary marketplace installer was not found. All five source credentials are PATs, so generic plugin OAuth wording is not a proven missing contract.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Recipe-specific compatibility and honest live matrix; new installer/OAuth requires a separately established contract.

implemented: Native mini-app authoring/messaging and JS APIs exist, including Figma local recipe tests.
gaps: Catalog registers five PAT plugins, not the separate JavaScript Sandbox/Mini Apps/Remotion bundles; preserved docs are not native discoverability.
Remotion workflow/Node/npm/video-toolchain compatibility unverified; importModule rejects. Small Buffer shim exists, but complete Node builtins are absent.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Register compatible source skills only after exact runtime recipe checks; detailed sandbox map belongs to core peer audit.

implemented: Five PAT schemas, DPAPI persistence, per-agent opaque handles, rotation/revocation and exact origins; raw plugin secrets remain in native host rather than source worker secretMap transport.
gaps: Source google-ai-key and automatically managed stagewise-auth are absent from native sandbox registry; model-provider Google keys are separate.
Generic public fields/onGet refresh registry not source equivalent; current PAT onGet functions are identity transforms.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Add source google-ai-key contract if needed; stagewise-auth requires real authorized account integration.

implemented: HTTP(S), origin-bound opaque substitution, manual credential redirects, public redirects, binary bodies, cancel/deadline/limits, reflection rejection and revocation.
gaps: Default1MiB upload/2MiB response/30s deadline and forbidden connection/cookie headers differ from full Node fetch; no complete streaming/cookie/multipart parity.
Browser pages and system Git authentication are separate; PATs are not injected into those contexts.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Actual-host fixtures for new fetch shapes while preserving origin, redirect and secret boundaries.

implemented: Native honestly offers BYOK and reports account authentication unavailable.
gaps: No OTP/email/social handoff, callback state/session refresh/logout or Stagewise token provider.
Public client contracts are preserved; backing /v1/auth implementation was not located in pinned apps. This does not prove the remote service is unavailable.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Choose an authorized backend, then native encrypted session/callback/nonce validation with fake service tests.

implemented: Local provider configuration remains independent of a hosted subscription.
gaps: No authenticated billing/plan/history panels; local token accounting is not account billing.
Pinned README:81 contains a planned account-service sunset notice; current remote availability and entitlements were not verified here.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Authorized backend contract with honest offline/expired states, no fabricated usage data.

gaps: No feed/channel/version query, download readiness, supersession or busy-agent install/restart flow.
Source updater excludes Linux/dev builds; do not inflate source support.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Owned signed feed/assets, atomic staging/rollback, busy-agent gate and restart fixtures.

Public server supplies release metadata, Windows RELEASES/nupkg and platform download routing; no native implementation/deployment is configured.

Bundle requires WebView2Loader.dll and installed Evergreen/Git/shell; no signed installer, protocol registration or clean-machine provisioning test.
Fresh source build is not bit-identical reproducible binary or clean install proof.

gaps: No OS custom protocol registration, single-instance auth callback routing or source startup deep-link validation.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Separate ADE scheme, strict allowlist/state validation; never take over Stagewise protocol by accident.

gaps: Electron Karton/dual-DevTools/window contracts differ. File name alone does not prove an external IDE API server.
Detailed browser/MiniApp parity is assigned to UI/browser peer audit.
capabilities.nextAcceptance: Each source RPC mapped to native action/result or explicit absence with ownership and screenshot bounds.

capabilities.nextAcceptance: Loopback-only random-token ingest, bounded channel/name/body and owner routing with rejection and lifecycle fixtures.

capabilities.nextAcceptance: Only if required: ADE-owned opt-in endpoint, redaction/batching and default-off tests.

supplementReview.selection: apps/update-server, browser root files, .storybook/etc/scripts/vite-plugins; text Git blobs only
supplementReview.license: Root AGPL LICENSE and original third-party notice retained; update-server has no local LICENSE or package license override found. private:true is an npm publication setting, not a restrictive copyright license.
supplementReview.restrictedAssets: Selected files contain source/config/docs; no binary/media/Nucleo icon assets were selected. Build scripts reference omitted assets, dependencies and signing configuration; no upstream code was executed.
supplementReview.bytePreservation: reference/.gitattributes applies ** -text; every supplemental blob hash checked.
supplementReview.noticeLimitation: Original third-party notice links third-party-licenses/class-variance-autority.txt, absent at inspected upstream pin; preserve notice faithfully, do not invent an unavailable file.
